offset_convention.definition: Byte offset from the beginning of usr/bin/mobile. For executable code in the first PT_LOAD, ELF virtual address equals file offset plus 0x10000.
offset_convention.example: ELF VA 0x49ef8 is mobile+0x39ef8. Addresses identify the write-wrapper callsite unless labelled routine_range.

known_limits: Unknown fields are deliberately retained as unknown rather than inferred from numeric proximity.
Consumers list confirmed native/web paths and important internal uses; it is not a proof that no additional inlined consumer exists.
The map distinguishes AP persistent policy from CP-derived runtime state; it does not imply that any setter is safe to exercise live.
